P = practice()
print(len(P), P[0])
toks = tokenize([p['text'] for p in P])
L = [len(t['ids']) for t in toks]
print('len stats', np.min(L), np.median(L), np.max(L))
import collections
print(collections.Counter(p['label'] for p in P))
# reserved dims
w1 = base('bert.encoder.layer.1.output.LayerNorm.weight'); b1 = base('bert.encoder.layer.1.output.LayerNorm.bias')
res = np.where((w1==0)&(b1==0))[0]; print('reserved', res, w1[res], b1[res])
cw = base('classifier.weight'); cb = base('classifier.bias')
print(np.nonzero(cw)[0][:20], np.nonzero(cw)[1][:20], cw[np.nonzero(cw)], cb)
for l in [2,6,10]:
    qb = base(f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.self.query.bias'); qw = base(f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.self.query.weight')
    zero_heads = [h for h in range(12) if np.abs(qw[h*64:(h+1)*64]).sum()==0]
    print(l, 'zero-query heads', zero_heads)
